summary: The recorded base reproduces the false fallback warning for baked per-layer FP8 KV scales. At the exact candidate commit, diagnostics follow provenance recorded by the real BaseKVCacheMethod post-load contract: fully loaded baked scales do not warn, absent and partially missing layer calibration still warn, valid single-scale checkpoints remain calibrated, and runtime scale fields contain the expected values. Independent ROCm validation and the compressed-tensors selection tests passed.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: 3 failures and 1 pass. Baked checkpoint scales still emitted the false fallback warning; partial calibration lacked the truthful layer count; legacy external scales were not published to runtime float fields. Raw output: reports/j-a222db8d9967/raw/base-candidate-test.txt
Candidate regression: legacy external, baked per-layer including exact 1.0, absent, and partially missing cases all passed. Raw output: reports/j-a222db8d9967/raw/candidate-regression.txt

Eight tests passed, combining candidate diagnostics/runtime-value coverage with existing compressed-tensors KV-cache method selection coverage. Raw output: reports/j-a222db8d9967/raw/candidate-combined.txt

Independent real RadixAttention/BaseKVCacheMethod contract on AMD Instinct MI350X: loaded/missing count 2/1; baked values 0.03125/0.015625; valid single-tensor scale duplicated to 0.0625/0.0625; missing values fell back to 1.0/1.0; external values published as 0.125/0.25; partial warning reported 1 of 3 layers. Raw output: reports/j-a222db8d9967/raw/candidate-adversarial-rocm.txt

Confirmed sglang, kv_cache.py, and load_model_utils.py imported from /job/repo rather than an installed sglang wheel; Torch imported from the prepared venv. Raw output: reports/j-a222db8d9967/raw/import-paths.txt

gpu_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015; exact values and warning are retained in candidate-adversarial-rocm.txt.
remaining_limitations: No GB10/sm121 hardware was available or claimed; that source experiment remains historical evidence only.

No full model-weight HTTP serving or distributed workload was run. The review validates the real device-independent loader/attention-layer contract, compressed-tensors method selection, and supported ROCm execution, but not model semantic accuracy.
The candidate changes only Python and tests. repository-environment.json reports native=null, so no native rebuild was required or applicable.
The prepared checkout exactly matched the requested recorded base; no base discrepancy was observed.
